items.title: Firefox listing gets its two 1280×800 screenshots, Productivity category, tags and the apps.gankdat.com homepage via the AMO API
items.why: Relay amo-listings 2026-09-30: the live AMO listing has previews 0, tags [], categories ['other'] and a github.io homepage — web-ext sign only ships the fields in assets/amo-metadata.json, never images or category. A listing with no screenshots and category 'other' is invisible in AMO's productivity browse pages and search; both extensions show 0 weekly downloads after eight days public. Build: scripts/amo-listing.ts (JWT from AMO_JWT_ISSUER/SECRET, POST previews from assets/screenshots/, PATCH homepage + tags + categories), unit-tested request shaping; the run is one ALERTS handoff line (keys only in .env), or rides foundry extension-publish-in-ci once the secrets exist. Same script serves ReadFocus.
items.proof: AMO weekly_downloads > 0 within 14 days of the previews going up (RESEARCH.md metrics row)

items.title: apps.gankdat.com/weava-alternative.html: a comparison page for burned Weava / Super Simple Highlighter users, linked from the landing and both listings
items.why: RESEARCH.md 2026-09-19: Weava (200k users, last update Feb 2024) reviews say 'no longer saves your highlights', 'no way to cancel', 'stole $240'; Super Simple Highlighter 'saved pages started to disappear'. Those users search 'weava alternative' / 'weava not saving highlights' and there is no page of ours answering it. STRATEGY §5: distribution beats features until the funnel converts — a static page is the cheapest channel we own (Search Console already indexes apps.gankdat.com). Page: side-by-side table (local storage, no account, $12 once vs $3.99–7.99/mo), one honest paragraph per rival, Markdown export, install buttons for Chrome and Firefox, the refund line.
items.proof: Search Console: ≥ 50 impressions or ≥ 5 clicks on the page in 30 days; any install attributed to it

items.title: Highlight PDFs opened in the browser (PDF.js viewer page with the same anchoring and library)
items.why: The most-asked gap in every rival's reviews (RESEARCH.md 2026-09-19: Weava 'PDF highlighting broken', Glasp iframe gaps). Real differentiator but a feature: behind the three distribution items above until the funnel shows any install. Needs a bundled PDF.js viewer page, per-file storage keyed by URL/hash, and the anchor model extended to page+offset.
